`final class VulkanRenderBridge`<br/>
**Extends:** [`RenderBridge`](/reference/bridges/renderbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.render` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanRenderBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/render/VulkanRenderBridge.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

The render bridge of Vulkan, which records each JOID frame into the command buffer of the host with the conventions of OpenGL.

## Description

It needs a device with Vulkan 1.3.
A resource deleted during a frame is destroyed once the frames in flight that may still read it are over.

## Learn more

- [Vulkan backend](/build/backends/vulkan/)
- [Render bridge](/build/bridges/render/)

## Creation details

<a id="VulkanRenderBridge-constructor"></a>

### VulkanRenderBridge

`VulkanRenderBridge(IVulkanHost host)` 

Creates the renderer for the host.
Throws an `IllegalArgumentException` when the host has no frame in flight, and an `IllegalStateException` when its device lacks Vulkan 1.3.

<a id="VulkanRenderBridge-method-suspend"></a>

### suspend

`void suspend(Runnable draw)` 

Ends the current render pass and runs the drawing, which can record its own commands into the command buffer of the host.

<a id="VulkanRenderBridge-method-raster"></a>

### raster

`void raster(IFrameBuffer target, int width, int height, Runnable draw)` 

Begins a render pass on the framebuffer with a viewport and a scissor of that size in pixels, and runs the drawing inside it.

<a id="VulkanRenderBridge-method-releaseHandle"></a>

### releaseHandle

`void releaseHandle(long handle)` 

Forgets the descriptor sets that use that image view; call it before you destroy a view that a [`VulkanBorrowedTexture`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanborrowedtexture/) lent.
